tagline: A configurable powerline status bar for Claude Code
brief: ccstatus renders a configurable status bar for Claude Code across four surfaces. The mark is the direction the user chose: H — a doubled left chevron («) built from the tool's powerline separator, reading as the two C's of Claude Code.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, native to a terminal, and reads as « / CC rather than a forward arrow.

concepts.name: H — Flow «
concepts.idea: The powerline separator doubled and reversed to point back — the two C's of Claude Code.
rationale: Built from the exact glyph ccstatus paints: the powerline chevron
Points back («) so it reads as CC, not a forward/next arrow
Two separated chevrons stay legible down to 16 px
Ink + terracotta nods to Claude; works in one colour and reversed

recommendation: H — Flow «, delivered as the full kit: symbol, reversed, one-colour, app icon, lockups, favicon/web-icon set and guidelines.
next_steps: Wire favicon/web-icons into any docs site
Outline the wordmark with licensed IBM Plex Mono for final lockups
